notes.title: Kinetic redesign
notes.text: Every Pokémon screen has a new default look: flat panels, Lucide line icons, Chakra Petch type and motion that follows the Animations setting. Phones get a bottom tab bar, safe-area spacing and thumb-sized controls. Original and Aperture remain in Settings.

notes.title: Poké Ball and move effects
notes.text: Pokémon are thrown out of and recalled into their balls, fainted and caught Pokémon return to a ball, and moves and status conditions play visual effects.

notes.title: Battle sprite sizing
notes.text: Battle Pokémon are sized by their visible pixels and species height, so HD models such as Giratina no longer appear tiny next to pixel sprites.
